# Topology_Aware_SNN_Placement

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The method of arranging spiking neuron layers and synaptic connections on FPGA logic blocks to minimize routing delays and energy consumption while preserving network topology. Shows how topology-centric design principles directly influence the performance of neuromorphic accelerators, a key concern for TCC hardware-software co-design.
